data.body: Investigation: Ran test suite with SUITE_TEST_INDEX set. Output shows 'TOLERATED (red-zone): tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh' — the single RED marker at test_structural_check_plugin_self_ref_runs_on_ci covers all 4 failing tests because they appear after the anchor line. The test file comment at lines 178-181 documents this intentional design: adding more markers would shift the last-wins boundary. No code change needed; proposed fix in bug description is incorrect. Leaving open pending user confirmation to close as invalid.
